Adventure Map — scroll to see all 5 nodes. Gold node pulses + tilts (current position,
2600ms shared ambient rhythm). The learner's own selected mascot avatar (not a generic owl)
bobs at the current node with a landing squash-and-settle on entrance, a soft ground shadow,
and a speech bubble. Completed nodes draw their checkmark in; unlocked nodes idle-tilt gently;
locked nodes wobble "no" on hover/tap. Ambient sparkles drift in the background.
Note: bg 2.png (and its siblings bg.png / bg 3.png) are all supplied at the same 864×1821 source resolution — this is the highest resolution available in the asset pack, there is no higher-res variant to swap in. If a sharper background is wanted, a new export from whoever produced the asset pack would be needed; in the meantime this preview renders it near native scale (no artificial upscaling) to avoid adding extra blur on top of the source.
